title: Add Internet Identity login/logout UI in header (desktop + mobile)

requirements.summary: Add a desktop header sign-in/sign-out control using the existing useInternetIdentity() hook, including loading and error UI.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not authenticated, the header shows a clearly labeled "Sign in" button.
Clicking "Sign in" triggers Internet Identity login via the existing `useInternetIdentity()` hook (no automatic login on page load).
While login is in progress, the sign-in button shows a loading state and is disabled to prevent duplicate attempts.
When the user is authenticated, the header shows the signed-in state (at minimum a "Sign out" button; optionally show a short/abbreviated principal).
Clicking "Sign out" logs the user out via the existing `clear()` function from `useInternetIdentity()` and returns the header to the signed-out state.
If a login error occurs, an understandable English error message is shown in the UI (inline near the auth control or as a dismissible alert).

file_operations.description: Create a reusable auth control component that uses the existing `useInternetIdentity()` hook to render: signed-out "Sign in" button (calls `login()` on click only), signed-in "Sign out" button (calls `clear()`), optional abbreviated principal display, a disabled/loading state while `isLoggingIn` is true, and an inline English error message when `isLoginError`/`loginError` are present. Compose existing shadcn/ui primitives (e.g., Button) rather than editing files under `frontend/src/components/ui`. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new AuthControls into the desktop header area alongside existing navigation, ensuring the control reflects authenticated vs signed-out states, shows loading/disabled behavior during login, and displays any login error message near the control. Keep SPA routing/layout intact and do not change immutable hook files. Compose existing shadcn/ui components already used by SiteHeader (Button/Sheet) and do not edit `frontend/src/components/ui/*`. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Expose the same sign-in/sign-out controls inside the mobile navigation sheet with matching loading/error behavior and correct state updates.
acceptanceCriteria: On mobile (sheet menu open), the user can sign in when signed out and sign out when signed in.
Auth controls in the mobile menu reflect the same loading and error states as the desktop header auth control.
Signing in/out updates the UI state correctly without requiring a manual refresh.

file_operations.description: Add the AuthControls component to the mobile Sheet menu content so authentication is available on small screens, matching the same loading/disabled/error states as desktop and reacting to identity changes without refresh. Ensure the mobile menu continues to use existing shadcn/ui Sheet primitives without editing `frontend/src/components/ui/*`. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
